alternative_explanations: Any quality gain may be ordinary finite-state context partitioning rather than event sparsity; the dense source-identical role isolates the clock intervention.
PPM-D or CTW may capture variable-order structure more accurately and cheaply, making learned states an inferior reparameterization.

falsification_criteria: Discard unless main improves mean, cold and worst-file bits per byte by at least 0.1671047931063159 versus both source-identical roles and the strongest complete implementable control in every K/D cell, with no accuracy regression.

Discard unless main update operations are below 0.60 of dense-clock in every cell, mean query operations are exactly K-independent at fixed D, state is at most 4194304 bytes and main is implementably Pareto-nondominated.
